name: Benziodarone

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France and United Kingdom, first in 1964 — for liver harm

similar.name: Benzbromarone
problems: Pulled from the market in France and Portugal, first in 2003 — for liver harm

similar.name: Benzarone

similar.name: Amiodarone
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm, breathing problems and liver harm

summary: Benziodarone was pulled from the market in France and the United Kingdom starting in 1964 due to liver harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a medium score of 57 for liver issues and a low score of 20 for heart issues [M]. Related drugs have also faced major issues, such as Benzbromarone and Benzarone being pulled from European markets for liver harm, and Amiodarone receiving a top-level boxed warning in the United States for liver harm, heart harm, and breathing problems [3][4][5].
